description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Synopsys is hiring a software engineering industrial placement student to support engineering software development and testing across multiple projects. The role includes Python development, expanding UI test frameworks, manual testing, and supporting CAD and FEA simulation workflows.
Software Engineering Industrial Placement developing Python-based PyAnsys CAE software and testing Discovery interfaces and MCP workflows

Responsibilities:
• As a shared resource supporting multiple exciting projects, you'll gain diverse experience across software development and testing:
• Develop and code using Python to support engineering software initiatives including PyAnsys-Geometry and PyAnsys-Discovery. Contribute to the expansion of the UI test suite framework using basic C# knowledge
• Conduct manual software testing across multiple platforms, including MCP testing and UI element testing in Discovery, ensuring quality and functionality
• Work with cutting-edge CAD and FEA tools to support simulation workflows and contribute to product development
• Collaborate with multiple team members across various projects, gaining exposure to different aspects of engineering software development
• Balance development and testing responsibilities, moving fluidly between coding assignments and quality assurance activities to support team objectives

Requirements:
• Currently pursuing a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
• Python programming experience
• Intermediate level exposure to CAD software (computer-aided design tools)
• Basic C# exposure
• Familiarity with UX design principles or user interface development, comfortable working in a Windows environment
• Adaptability and flexibility to work across multiple projects and switch between development and testing tasks
• Strong problem-solving abilities and eagerness to learn unfamiliar engineering and software workflows
• Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively with multiple team members
• Practical, hands-on approach to tackling diverse technical challenges

Preferred:
• Academic or practical experience with FEA (Finite Element Analysis)
